General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter how many cigarettes you smoked per day.
  2. Enter the price of a 20-cigarette pack.
  3. Enter your quit date.
  4. See money saved to date plus 1-year and 5-year projections.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are savings calculated?

Days since your quit date × (cigarettes per day ÷ 20) × pack price. Future projections use the same daily saving rate.

How much can I really save?

A pack-a-day smoker at typical prices saves thousands per year — the 1-year and 5-year projections show the full picture.

I slipped up — is this still useful?

Yes — the calculation is pure arithmetic on the numbers you enter; no judgment, just motivation.
